# Common physical power balance and a conservative-lattice receiver

Live author construction. No unrestricted recurrence theorem is claimed. The purpose is to remove unnecessary activity/exponential-tail demands and earn an actual receiver before composing rare switch episodes. The stopped-Lyapunov/Filonov base is ordinary established machinery.

## 1. Exact power balance, with the same actual stop

Let V>=0 be a common marked energy and U=(1+V)^2. For an actual stopping episode with finite second energy increment and finite physical mean, put

    Z=V_out-V_in, d=-E Z, b=E Z^2, T=E sigma.

Then EXACTLY

    E[U_out-U_in+sigma]=-2(1+V_in)d+b+T.                      (Q1)

Thus 2(1+V)d>=b+T is a sufficient physical-return inequality. No uniform contraction, q reward or finite expected jump count is required. This is an identity to be earned at the actual stop, not a supplied moment interface. Finite words acquire these quantities by exact channel probabilities and actual holding means. Finite killed cells acquire them by their complete Green/exit law. Global coverage and sign still need proof.

The finite marked diagnostics in marked_physical_dp.py find paid negative values for both the banked slow ordered cycle and the neutral coupled network. They also preserve the conservative angular counterexample. Those fixtures are not a global proof.

## 2. Remove genuine conservative circulation from the energy

Let L be the integer lattice generated by the raw total-count-preserving reaction vectors. Every l in L has sum zero. For x>=0 define

    Phi_L(x)=min{H(z): z>=0 integer, z-x in L},
    H(z)=sum_i log(z_i!).                                    (Q2)

This minimum is ACQUIRED mathematically from a finite set: sum z_i=sum x_i. It is normlike, since H(z)>=n log(n/d)-n for n=sum x_i, and Phi_L(x)<=H(x). It is exactly invariant under any feasible L displacement. No stationary distribution, mixing gap, dynamically reachable fiber or infinite-rate limit is assumed. The lattice fiber is a representation, not a substitute physical process.

For a single primitive/raw conservative direction, exact minimization can be particularly cheap; the paired-transfer diagnostic below has a one-dimensional strictly convex factorial objective and a binary-search comparison of eight integer factors. A general numerical solver would have to pay its own integer-fiber minimization cost.

# Actual killed-Green landing tails and a nonlinear service operation

Author derivation. These are complete local operations with their actual input/output contracts, not a global recurrence proof. No actual trajectory is replaced by an equilibrium fiber.

## 1. A reference-weight identity controls actual landings

For the diagnostic's conservative pair, use physical fiber index k with x(k)=x(0)+kw. Its genuine forward/backward rates satisfy the EXACT edge balance identity with the positive reference weight

    w(k)=2^k / product_i x_i(k)!.

This identity is used algebraically, not as a law of the input or of a surviving trajectory. Add ALL noncore hazards h(k), including the constant total zero-source hazard2, and put G=(-Q_core+diag h)^(-1). Diagonal killing preserves the exact weighted symmetry

    w(i)G(i,j)=w(j)G(j,i).                                   (G1)

Every row sum of G is an actual mean exit time <=1/2. Thus

    G(i,j)<=w(j)/(2w(i)).                                    (G2)

For any set B of exit locations, the COMPLETE actual exit law obeys

    P_i(exit location in B)
       <=[1/(2w(i))] sum_(j in B) w(j)h(j).                  (G3)

If -log w(j)>=-log w(i)+a on B, (G3) is <=|B|h_max exp(-a)/2. Here |B| and h_max have explicit polynomial count bounds from the fixed raw list. A linear-in-population reference barrier therefore gives a paid exponentially small cold landing probability, with its actual source/landing weight. No uniform mixing gap or conditional independence is used. It is NOT a uniform assertion from arbitrary high-energy entries; the barrier separation must actually hold at the input.

## 2. Uniform actual-time service from every fiber composition

Fix actual A=2,D=1 until the first noncore event. Write S=B+E and suppose

    |B-C|<=R, |E-F|<=R,
    S>=max(64(R+1),96).

The conservative rates are f=4(B)_2(C)_2 and g=2(E)_2(F)_2. The desired noncore service is I2 with h_high=2BC. ALL competing noncore hazards total h_low=2+2B+E<=5S. The invariant S and the two differences stay fixed throughout this entire actual core episode.

Let u(B)=1/(B+1). Direct genuine generator differences give

    L_core u <=8C^2 -4(E)_2(F)_2/[(B+1)(B+3)].               (G4)

At B=0 or1 the absent forward channel is simply omitted; the displayed upper bound remains valid. For B<=S/16, the size assumptions give C<=S/8, E,F>=S/2 and (B+1)(B+3)<=S^2/64,

source_excerpts.text:
# A finite-capacity packet mark for normal interleavings

Live representation construction, not a global recurrence theorem. It removes a spurious debt caused by erasing an unfinished packet when another cycle starts; it does not yet pay genuine repeated-source loans.

## Exact augmented dynamics

Take a fixed number K of auxiliary packet slots, each carrying a raw complex or the empty zero placeholder. Let tau be the sum of the carried complexes. Define the admissible augmented state by the condition that the lattice class x-tau+L has a nonnegative representative, and set

    Psi(x,packets)=Phi_L(x-tau), U=(1+Psi)^2.

Here Phi_L is defined on ANY signed integer representative whose L class meets the nonnegative orthant. A packet mark is auxiliary bookkeeping, NOT a claim that its molecules remain physically segregated or that the physical process has the carried-target mark of the earlier theorem.

Each genuine raw channel is counted ONCE with its actual propensity. There is no rate multiplication by the number of matching slots.

* For a conservative-core channel, retain the packet modes. Its physical displacement is in L, so Psi is exactly unchanged.
* If a noncore source s equals one occupied packet complex, update one deterministic matching slot s->u. Then physical x and tau change by the same vector; Psi is exactly unchanged. A zero-source reaction may advance an empty slot when one exists.
* For every other actual channel, reset to one slot carrying its actual product u and all other slots empty. The new residual x'-u=x-s is genuinely nonnegative. Its actual output is always represented and its receiving value is Phi_L(x-s); it is not dropped or supplied externally.

The physical marginal is EXACTLY the original chain. Normal source steps and arbitrary conservative-core interleavings preserve the same quotient energy. In particular, two cycles' simultaneous normal packets do not lose the first packet's credit merely because the second zero-source input fired.

Since K is finite and the raw mark sizes are bounded, |tau| is uniformly bounded. Every nonnegative representative of x-tau+L has total N(x)-|tau|, so Psi is normlike uniformly over all packet modes. Allowing UNBOUNDED packet capacity would destroy that implication: an indefinitely growing population could be stored entirely in the marks at constant residual energy. That is a decisive constrain
